quarterly_data.quarter: Flex press release: Flex Expands Prefabricated Modular Data Center Portfolio to (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Flex introduced Axiom AI Modules in its Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment: prefabricated, factory-built modular data center systems integrating an 800 VDC Power Rack (power conversion and distribution for 800 VDC AI infrastructure), advanced cooling distribution units (CDUs) for liquid cooling, and high-density IT racks integrating AI servers, networking and high-speed interconnects. Flex says they reduce deployment timelines by up to 50% compared with traditional construction approaches. Flex states it is actively building prefabricated modular solutions for hyperscalers across its global footprint, including more than three million square feet of dedicated data center infrastructure manufacturing capacity in the U.S.
quarterly_data.figure: deployment timelines reduced by up to 50%; more than three million square feet of dedicated U.S. data center infrastructure manufacturing capacity
